mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.status, u.deleted_at, COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT assigned_role.code ORDER BY assigned_role.code) FROM t_user_role user_role JOIN t_role assigned_role ON assigned_role.id = user_role.role_id WHERE user_role.user_id = u.id), '{}') AS role_codes, COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT permission.code ORDER BY permission.code) FROM t_user_role user_role JOIN t_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = user_role.role_id JOIN t_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE user_role.user_id = u.id), '{}') AS permission_codes FROM t_user u WHERE u.username = #{username}
